title: AiPluginUtteranceDef - Metadata API
description: Represents an utterance that can be used to pick a topic during runtime.
file_information: AiPluginUtteranceDef components are part of other components, such as GenAiPlugin, and aren't used separately.

developerName.description: Represents the API name of the utterance. Can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores.

masterLabel.description: The master label for the utterance.
